subject.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity

question: Should native apps own this focused Automations management subset, and should the outstanding Skills corrections remain bundled in the same PR?
rationale: The implementation adds a substantial native product surface and combines an adjacent feature's follow-up changes; repository policy and the protected label require an owner to confirm that scope even after correctness and proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Approve combined native scope
options.body: Accept the focused Automations parity and bundled Skills follow-ups after pagination, proof, and merge conflicts are resolved.

options.title: Split the Skills follow-ups
options.body: Keep this PR limited to Automations and move the unrelated Skills corrections into a narrow follow-up PR.

options.title: Defer native parity
options.body: Retain the web Control UI as the management surface and close or substantially narrow this native feature direction.

recommendation.title: Approve combined native scope
recommendation.body: Accept the focused Automations parity and bundled Skills follow-ups after pagination, proof, and merge conflicts are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to both the canonical feature proposal and the recently merged native Skills surface.
